video_title: Roommates Show LIVE at MSG 🚨 Melo, KAT & More Join Jalen, Josh after Knicks NBA Championship

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith apologizes to the Knicks organization for his past criticism
quotes.excerpt: I have never been more happy to be wrong in my life.

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
text_blocks.text: I apologize to this brother on national television. I'm apologizing to you. I'm apologizing to the entire Knicks organization. But let me be very, very clear. I have never been more happy to be wrong in my life.

text_blocks.speaker: Josh Hart
text_blocks.text: I apologize to this brother on national television. I'm apologizing to you. I'm apologizing to the entire Knicks organization.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith critiques the Knicks' draft history and roster building
quotes.excerpt: We got the eighth pick in 2009, Steph Curry going number seven. We got number three pick the year Zion and Ja go number one and two.

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
text_blocks.text: We got the eighth pick in 2009, Steph Curry going number seven. We got number three pick the year Zion and Ja go number one and two. Everything that happened, you come out in the draft, you're the 30th pick. We drafted Frank Ntilikina in that draft. You were a second round pick. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander was in the first round along with a host of other cats. Everything that happened, we were missing.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith praises the Knicks' 13-0 run and playoff performance
quotes.excerpt: You went 13 and 0. I'll apologize for being wrong, but let me be very clear, if it means another championship, I'd do it again.

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
text_blocks.text: You went 13 and 0. I'll apologize for being wrong, but let me be very clear, if it means another championship, I'd do it again. I'd do it again.

text_blocks.speaker: Jalen Brunson
text_blocks.text: So, when Stephen A. mentioned Atlanta and what he said and then what sort of came after that, when you guys are in the heat of a playoff series, you're down 2-1, how much are you looking at that outside noise?

text_blocks.speaker: Josh Hart
text_blocks.text: I honestly don't think we thought about it or even heard it.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony reflects on his journey and his son's experience
quotes.excerpt: For him to have an opportunity to experience this, I couldn't be able to tell 19 years of my journey without telling his story too.
quotes.quote: For him to have an opportunity to experience this, I couldn't be able to tell 19 years of my journey without telling his story too. You get a chance to see me shut one door which is Hall of Fame and then he opens another door which is going in the Syracuse. I'm just a I can support those guys, I can be a fan of the game, I can come to the game, give my little advice here and there, but like that's your shit man, so you got to enjoy that shit, please do enjoy for us, enjoy for everybody who's been a part of this organization and families and mothers and fathers and grandparents had the opportunity to get tickets so.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on the pressure of wearing a Knicks jersey
quotes.excerpt: No one knows the understand besides y'all that wear the jersey, no one understands the weight that that jersey has sometimes.
quotes.quote: No one knows the understand besides y'all that wear the jersey, no one understands the weight that that jersey has sometimes. And, you know, we kind of talk around it and dance around it, but New York is a special place, but there's a lot of pressure when you put that jersey on. So we want to thank you and celebrate you a little bit, man, for laying the foundation, but also, you know, talking to us during it.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the team's mindset during the playoff run
quotes.excerpt: after the loss, none of us panicked. I said, we're going to get out of this
quotes.quote: It wasn't really after the wins, but after the loss, none of us panicked. You know what I mean? And I said, we're going to get out of this and we're going to go win a chip. I truly felt that.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the team's reaction to the Atlanta series
quotes.excerpt: we all looked at that like this is just a step. This isn't the destination
quotes.quote: Obviously winning the Eastern Conference is an amazing accomplishment, but we all looked at that like this is just a step. This isn't the destination. This is just a step, and the reaction after Game 4 in Cleveland shows that.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the team's respect for opponents
quotes.excerpt: we always give that respect. We always respect the game and the opponent
quotes.quote: For us, we always give that respect. We always respect the game and the opponent, because sometimes us not playing our best is because they came out with a level of intensity and they imposed their will on the game and they didn't allow us to play our best.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the team's underdog mentality
quotes.excerpt: Every time we stepped on the court, they were always telling us we're the underdogs
quotes.quote: Every time we stepped on the court, they were always telling us we're the underdogs. We were the prey. We were the people that couldn't get it done, and our locker room always thought we were the predators. We were the one coming out there to get the job done.

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart on his role in setting the tone for the team
quotes.excerpt: I wanted to make sure I go out there and utilize my experience
quotes.quote: I already know what Cap was going to do, and you heard me on TV say I'm working every step of the way. So I had to make sure I was right there with him and getting the job done. So I just wanted to make sure I go out there and utilize my experience, and I just remember that it brought up that same matchup like me versus Jokic in the Denver series, and I wanted to kind of bring that physicality and intensity to the game.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on the importance of team trust
quotes.excerpt: to have teammates like y'all who believed in me that much, I had to repay that trust
quotes.quote: To have teammates like y'all who believed in me that much, in a big point of our season like that, to hear me out, trust in what I thought could take us to another level, I had to repay that trust, man, and I had to go and show the best version of myself.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson on his relationship with his teammates
quotes.excerpt: I want to make sure I amplify you to a whole another level
quotes.quote: I said, I want to make sure I amplify you to a whole another level that you haven't even recognized for yourself. I want to be that partner in crime that you haven't been, you haven't had, and I want to make sure that every step of the way, anytime you go anywhere, you're never alone.

quotes.speaker: Shannon Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Shannon Hart on the balance of Josh Hart's personality
quotes.excerpt: he has a good balance of like when it comes to being a dad
quotes.quote: I think he has a good balance of like when it comes to being a dad. Like he's the fun one, like doesn't really discipline, which annoys me sometimes, but he's super loving and he's the fun one and he's always like really good to the boys. I'm the disciplinarian and they all don't always love me, which is annoying because then he's the good cop and I'm always the bad cop, but it's a good balance.

quotes.speaker: Ali Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Ali Brunson on Jalen Brunson's calm demeanor at home
quotes.excerpt: He brings like a sense of calmness to our house
quotes.quote: He brings like a sense of calmness to our house. Like he'll come home and he's just this very chill vibe, and look, he's the king. No, that's he does that perfectly. He'll like bring a good zen vibe into the house.

quotes.speaker: Samara Hillman
quotes.summary_phrase: Samara Hillman on Josh Hart's ability to handle chaos
quotes.excerpt: You thrive in chaos in the way I don't, so it's good
quotes.quote: You thrive in chaos in the way I don't, so it's good. You keep me grounded. Like that.

quotes.speaker: Ali Brunson
quotes.summary_phrase: Ali Brunson on Jalen Brunson's personality
quotes.excerpt: He's very type A and I'm a very type B person
quotes.quote: He's very type A and I'm a very type B person. There are times where he like will go through a cleaning streak in the house. He's like, all right, drop everything, we're going to get this house back in order. So it'll be like the most random times we're in the middle of something and he's like, all right, let's do this, let's clean out the closet.
